segments.text:
EVery good gifte, and euery perfect gifte, is from aboue, & commeth doune from the father of lightes, with whom is no variablenes, neither is he chaū
ged vnto darkenes. Of his owne will begate he vs, with the worde of trueth, that we ſhoulde be the firſte fruites of his creatures. Wherfore (dere brethren) let euery man be ſwift to heare, ſlowe to ſpeake, ſlowe to wrathe. For the wrathe of man worketh not that which is righteous before God. Wherfore laye aparte all filthines, and ſuperfluitie of maliciouſnes, & receiue with mekenes the word that is graffed in you, whiche is able to ſaue your ſoules.
